articles.description:
Delta Lake: A Production Deep Dive



  
  
  Introduction


The relentless growth of data volume and velocity presents a significant engineering challenge: building reliable, performant, and cost-effective data pipelines. Traditional data lakes, built on object storage like S3 or Azure Blob Storage, often suffer from issues like data corruption, inconsistent reads, and the lack of ACID transactions. These problems manifest as failed ETL jobs, incorrect analytics, and ultimately, a loss of trust in the data.  We recently faced this acutely while building a real-time fraud detection system processing 10TB/day of transactional data with sub-second query latency requirements.   Introduction


The V8 engine, developed by Google for use in Chrome and Node.js, is an open-source JavaScript engine built using C++.
